KOS-0160_kaveri_clean.pdf.story: Happy path from a real PDF: text extracted, matched to PO-1011 and GRN-5011, CGST+SGST correct for a Tamil Nadu supplier.

KOS-0161_kaveri_scanned.pdf.story: Scanned paper invoice (no text layer): OCR reads every field and the match is clean, but OCR reads are never auto-approved in v1, so a person confirms the fields.

BL-5651_brightline_igst.pdf.story: Different vendor layout. Supplier and buyer are both in Tamil Nadu, so CGST+SGST applies, but the PDF charges IGST.

DE-0413_deccan_high_value.pdf.story: Inter-state supply (Karnataka to Tamil Nadu) with IGST, correct. Everything matches, but INR 6.8 lakh is above the INR 5 lakh auto-approval limit.
